semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Mitsubishi Chemical Corporation is developing soundproofing solutions specifically aimed at addressing noise and vibration issues in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Mitsubishi Chemical Corporation is showcasing its innovative soundproofing sheet, Reso-Core™, designed to mitigate noise and vibration challenges in semiconductor manufacturing. The product utilizes advanced acoustic metamaterial technology to enhance soundproofing performance, making it relevant for processes requiring precision and microfabrication.
capabilities: Reso-Core™ Type-A for vibration damping and isolation
